use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: To allow the customer to view the status of current and past auctions, including details such as start/end times, number of items, and results.

goal.raw_text: To allow the customer to view the status of current and past auctions, including details such as start/end times, number of items, and results.

claims.content: The customer navigates to the 'Auction Admin' section or a dedicated auction status page.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to the 'Auction Admin' section or a dedicated auction status page.

claims.content: The system displays a list of current and past auctions.
For each auction, the system shows key details including start/end times, number of items, and results (for past auctions).
The customer can select an auction to view more detailed information about it.
If the customer has not yet registered for an auction, they can register from this page.
The customer has successfully viewed the status of current and past auctions.
The system has displayed key details for each auction, including start/end times, number of items, and results (for past auctions).
If selected by the customer, detailed information about a specific auction is displayed.
